content.title: Find value beyond China's internet giants with these stocks
content.description:
Besides major e-commerce players Alibaba (BABA, 9988.HK) and JD.com (JD, 9618.HK), what are some smaller Chinese stocks that investors should be aware of?

KraneShares CIO Brendan Ahern comes on Market Domination to speak more about Chinese stocks like Tencent Music (TME), Bilibili (BILI, 9626.HK), and Kuaishou Technology (1024.HK).

Ahern's firm manages the KraneShares CSI China Internet ETF (KWEB) and KraneShares Global Humanoid and Embodied Intelligence Index ETF (KOID).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
